# DoctorsManagement

> > Full-service healthcare consulting and auditing firm specializing in medical practice management, compliance, and revenue optimization.

DoctorsManagement is a comprehensive practice management consulting firm based in Knoxville, TN, serving medical and dental practices with expertise in operations, revenue cycle management, compliance, accounting, and regulatory requirements. The firm combines strategic consulting with specialized services including HR recruitment, credentialing, tax planning, and practice assessments.

## Key Topics

- Practice Management Consulting
- Revenue Cycle Management
- Healthcare Compliance
- Medical Practice Operations
- HIPAA & CLIA Regulations
- Practice Startup & Transitions
- Accounting & Tax Planning
- Provider Credentialing
- Direct Primary Care
- Medicare & Medicaid Enrollment
- HR Recruitment
- False Claims Act Compliance
- Dental Practice Management
- PowerBuying Program
- Healthcare Enforcement

## Core Consulting Services

- [Medical Practice Consultants & Auditors - DoctorsManagement](https://www.doctorsmanagement.com): DoctorsManagement homepage: full-service healthcare consulting and auditing firm.
- [Medical Practice Management Consulting Services](https://www.doctorsmanagement.com/practice-management): Expert consulting to optimize operations, revenue, and patient care.
- [Medical Practice Operations Consulting Services](https://www.doctorsmanagement.com/practice-operations): Operations consulting for workflow optimization and revenue cycle management.
- [Medical Practice Assessment & Review - DoctorsManagement](https://www.doctorsmanagement.com/practice-assessment): Practice assessments analyzing financial standing and revenue improvement strategies.
- [Revenue Cycle Management Consulting For Medical Practices](https://www.doctorsmanagement.com/revenue-cycle-management): RCM consulting to maximize revenue, reduce denials, and improve efficiency.
- [Dental Practice Management Consulting Services](https://www.doctorsmanagement.com/dental-practice-management): Consulting for dental practices covering operations, revenue, and profitability.
